$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFOX (AIP France, AMDT 13/23, chart dated 2023-11-30).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds
what the simulator does not know: services, circuit rules and reporting points.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Étampes-Mondésir

service.classG: aerodrome in class G: VFR traffic without radio may transit nearby or overhead

preferredQfuReason: environment: avoid overflying neighbouring built-up areas

circuit.lowHeightPattern: 300 ft minimum ASFC, north of the runway only
circuit.weekendsAndHolidays: special exercises reserved for home-based aircraft
circuit.specialExercises: E-pattern, U-pattern and low-height pattern on the grass runway with an instructor on board only

notes: Air-air frequency 119.050 is for French only. Simultaneous use of the two runways is prohibited.
Southerly wind: turbulence on the paved runway (hangars) and on final 24 or take-off 06 (helicopter work area).
Paved taxiways limited to 15 m wingspan; helicopter translation way TANGO reserved for helicopters.
Regular activity of low-flying military helicopters on the military area south of the aerodrome.
Aerobatics (NR 6215) 2500-4500 ft AMSL, according to protocol; paragliding winching 6 km south.
